summary: You produced a clear, well-structured ethics report that argues convincingly for not shipping. You identified key issues in INTRODUCTION, listed stakeholders comprehensively, and used strong cases. To reach Excellent across all criteria, strengthen stakeholder-specific recommendations, add quantitative evidence and visuals, and refine referencing accuracy.
next_steps: In DISCUSSION, add a simple table weighing stakeholders (Rachel, company, health department, end-users) with distinct decision recommendations to reach Excellent in C2 and C3.
Strengthen C4 by adding one quantitative trade-off (e.g., estimated recall/fine cost vs contract revenue) and fix References [3][4] with access dates and consistent Harvard style.
For C5, correct heading typo DICUSSION to DISCUSSION and insert one visual (stakeholder map or risk matrix) to support your argument and move from Good to Very Good.

criteria.C1: You excelled here. In INTRODUCTION you identified several issues like "maintaining product quality safety while trying to succeed as a business" and linked them to engineering design/organisations. You comprehensively listed stakeholders including "many people who will use... services of the government health department." Keep this depth.
criteria.C2: You built objective for/against arguments in DISCUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship covering revenue and competitive advantage versus harm and integrity. Your CONCLUSION that risks are "colossal" follows logically. For Excellent, add tailored decision guidance for each stakeholder, not just Rachel.
criteria.C3: Your structure from ABSTRACT through RECOMMENDATION flows logically and your argument in The Most Ethical Path systematically builds to "decision to Not Ship is certainly the most ethical path." For Excellent, make the trade-offs explicit for all stakeholders to show systematic understanding.
criteria.C4: Good use of qualitative evidence: Apple releases, HSSIB IT failures, and VW emissions scandal in The Most Ethical Path. To reach Very Good, add quantitative evidence as noted in marking and ensure References are consistently formatted with full details.
criteria.C5: Your report has clear sections including ABSTRACT and INTRODUCTION and fluent writing. To reach Very Good, you need visual elements as required, and to correct errors cited in marking such as "DICUSSION" and the malformed URL "Avww" in References.
